notes.title: The Pegasus Expedition Has Left Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We would like to let you know that [b]the sci-fi story-driven 4X strategy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url][/b] has just left Early Access!

[previewyoutube=NKqW3jrau0I;full][/previewyoutube]

During the first week after the full launch, it will be [b]15% off[/b], so get your hands on it as soon as possible. There is also a deal running where you can get The Pegasus Expedition in a bundle with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/214730/Space_Rangers_HD_A_War_Apart/]Space Rangers HD: A War Apart[/url]. This bundle is discounted by another 10% and that counts even if you already own one of the included games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33272/

If you want to know more about The Pegasus Expedition, check out its [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]Steam page[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j571281gDi4]watch the official release trailer[/url] or join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/GnRDhUXzBV]Discord[/url] where you can chat directly with the developers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

notes.title: Perimeter is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!

[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: Watch, wishlist, play - The Pegasus Expedition jumps into Early Access soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As you may have noticed, Fulqrum Publishing are working on an epic narrative 4X strategy [b]The Pegasus Expedition[/b]! [b]The game will be launching into Early Access on October 20[/b]!

You will get an exclusive chance to take a closer look at its gameplay, for our favorite streamer [b]Jared Bair[/b] will be playing the game on his [url=https://www.twitch.tv/jaredrbair]Twitch channel[/url] along with the developer [b]Jaakko Vesterinen[/b], who will be commenting! Tune in on [b]October 13, 11PM CEST (5PM EST)[/b].

Watch the Early Access release date revelation trailer below:

[previewyoutube=Y73QXRc6jLc;full][/previewyoutube]

You still have a chance to play the DEMO of the game on Steam, hurry up though, it won't be available forever! And we would be very happy if you added The Pegasus Expedition to your wishlists, it helps more than you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Last but not least, don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] to get all the news not only about The Pegasus Expedition, and perhaps even win some free games!

notes.title: The Pegasus Expedition needs you, Commander! Will you answer the call?
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone,

On behalf of the team here at 1C, we are happy to announce our collaboration with indie developer Kalla Gameworks to bring their upcoming 4X grand strategy, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url], to PC this year. Aspiring Fleet Commanders will soon be able to get a little taste of what it has to offer, as we can confirm [b]a playable demo will be available for you to enjoy during the upcoming Steam Next Fest, starting June 13, 2022![/b]

For now, you can at least take a look at the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url] trailer:

[previewyoutube=in1bLfzbgHk;full][/previewyoutube]

And if you like what you see, go ahead and wishlist the game, so you don't miss any news about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url] is a story-driven sci-fi grand strategy game set in a key moment for humankind’s survival. Facing an overwhelming threat at home, humanity sends an expedition to the Pegasus Galaxy in a desperate attempt to find a refuge for the population of Earth, only to find themselves in the middle of an interstellar war they inadvertently started.

As you lead one of these fleets, your mission soon transitions from exploration to governance, conquest, and eventually a fight for survival. Players will experience a challenging story where nothing is self-evident and every decision will have its consequences.

Building on the legacy of the grand strategy genre, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url] adds a strong narrative side to the classic 4X-gameplay which involves managing your diplomatic ties, armies, economy and scientific development.

We encourage you to come to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/1c-entertainment]Discord server[/url], just as the [url=https://discord.gg/CvsDfa28]developer's[/url], we will be happy to hear from you!
